newsitem.title: USA: Hilton to seek earliest date for ITT bid.
newsitem.headline: Hilton to seek earliest date for ITT bid.

text.p: Hilton Hotels Corp said Monday it would still try to get ITT Corp shareholders to vote early on its hostile bid for ITT even though a judge had stopped it from calling an early annual meeting.

"We are confident that ITT's shareholders recognize the enormous benefits of a Hilton-ITT combination, and we will continue to seek the earliest opportunity to let the shareholders decide this matter," it said in a statement released hours after the judge's decision.

Earlier on Monday, U.S. District Judge Philip Pro denied a motion by Hilton to oblige ITT to hold its annual meeting in mid-May. The decision ended Hilton's attempt to force a quick shareholder vote on its $6.5 billion hostlie bid for the company.
"ITT can run from its shareholders, but it cannot hide," Hilton said. "ITT's delay of its annual meeting in no way changes the fact that Hilton has put a compelling offer on the table."

At the ITT annual meeting, Hilton plans to ask the shareholders of ITT to elect up to 25 Hilton nominees to the board of directors of ITT. The nominees are expected to facilitate Hilton's $55-per-share offer to acquire ITT and the proposed Hilton-ITT merger.
